# 想 + Verb · *soeng2 + Verb*

**Meaning:** would like to / want to · **Level:** A1 · **Topic:** Wants, needs and ability

> ⚠️ **Draft — awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [open an issue](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new).

想 before a verb says what you would like to do. It is softer and more polite than 要.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我想飲水。** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 soeng2 jam2 seoi2. |
| Yale | ngóh séung yám séui. |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄙㆦㄥ² ㄧㄜㆬ² ㄙㆤㄧ². |
| English | I'd like some water. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我想學廣東話。** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 soeng2 hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2. |
| Yale | ngóh séung hohk gwóng dūng wá. |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄙㆦㄥ² ㄏㄛㆶ⁶ ㄍㄨㄛㄥ² ㄉㄨㄥ¹ ㄨㄚ². |
| English | I want to learn Cantonese. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **你想去邊度呀？** |
| Jyutping | nei5 soeng2 heoi3 bin1 dou6 aa3? |
| Yale | néih séung heui bīn douh a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄝㄧ⁵ ㄙㆦㄥ² ㄏㆤㄧ³ ㄅㄧㄣ¹ ㄉㄛㄨ⁶ ㄚ³? |
| English | Where would you like to go? |
